metrics.zd: Artificial Analysis 用 10 项独立测评（推理、知识、数学、编程、长文、指令遵循等）算出的 0–100 综合分，作为本榜总分。
metrics.ed: Artificial Analysis's 0–100 composite of 10 independent evaluations (reasoning, knowledge, math, coding, long context, instruction following); used as the overall score.

metrics.zd: 在真实命令行环境里完成软件工程任务的通过率，由 Vals AI 用统一框架独立测试。
metrics.ed: Pass rate on real command-line software tasks, run independently by Vals AI with one shared harness.

metrics.zd: 「人类最后的考试」：数学、科学、人文等领域的专家级难题正确率，测的是深度推理。
metrics.ed: Humanity's Last Exam: accuracy on expert-level questions across math, science and the humanities, a test of deep reasoning.

metrics.zd: 长文推理测评：阅读约 10 万 token 的报告、论文、法律文件后回答综合问题，最接近「读长文并总结」的能力。
metrics.ed: Long-context reasoning: answer synthesis questions after reading ~100K tokens of reports, papers and legal documents; the closest proxy for reading and summarizing long material.

metrics.zd: 用户在匿名对战中给两个模型生成的网页投票得出的 Elo 分，反映真实用户对前端编程的偏好。
metrics.ed: Elo from users voting between two anonymous models' generated web apps; reflects real-user preference for front-end coding.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.zn: 多数榜单第一；编程、推理、网页对战都领先。
models.en: Tops most boards; leads coding, reasoning and WebDev.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.zn: 编程接近 Opus 5.5，价格只有一半。
models.en: Coding close to Opus 5.5 at half the price.

models.name: Muse Wonder Full
models.zn: Meta 首个前沿模型的高配版，仅 Muse Code 订阅可用；其他单项只有 Meta 自报数据，未收录。
models.en: Meta's top frontier tier, Muse Code subscribers only; other scores are Meta's own, so not shown.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.zn: Anthropic 更大的旗舰模型，推理分很高。
models.en: Anthropic's larger flagship, with a high reasoning score.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.zn: OpenAI 最强模型；在 Scale 实验室的 HLE 快照中排第一。
models.en: OpenAI's most capable model; leads Scale Labs' own HLE snapshot.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.zn: Google 新旗舰；有一个来源显示其 LMArena 文本榜第一（1532），尚待证实。
models.en: Google's new flagship; one source puts it first on LMArena text (1532), unconfirmed.

models.name: Muse Wonder
models.zn: 可通过 Meta Model API 使用的版本，定价与 Opus 5.5 相同。
models.en: The Meta Model API tier, priced the same as Opus 5.5.

models.name: GPT-6 Sol
models.zn: GPT-6 中端主力，价格是 5.6 代的一半。
models.en: GPT-6's mid-tier workhorse at half the 5.6 price.

models.name: MiMo-V2.6-Pro
models.zn: 目前得分最高的开源模型。
models.en: The highest-scoring open-weight model right now.

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.zn: xAI 面向编程和智能体的前沿模型。
models.en: xAI's frontier model for coding and agents.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017)
models.zn: 10 月 17 日更新后综合分从 39.5 升到 45.1。
models.en: The Oct 17 update lifted it from 39.5 to 45.1.

models.name: GLM-5.3
models.zn: 智谱旗舰；HLE 为不使用工具的成绩（带工具时官方称 62.5）。
models.en: Zhipu's flagship; HLE without tools (62.5 with tools per Z.ai).

models.name: Kimi K3
models.en: No. 1 in the world on long-document understanding (AA-LCR).

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.zn: 小模型中得分最高之一，超过 GPT-6 Luna。
models.en: One of the strongest small models, ahead of GPT-6 Luna.

models.name: Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B
models.zn: 千问 3.8 最大的开源版本；Qwen 4 仍在训练中。
models.en: The largest open Qwen3.8; Qwen 4 is still in training.

models.name: Mistral Large 4 (preview)
models.zn: 欧洲得分最高的模型，目前为预览版。
models.en: Europe's highest-scoring model, still in preview.
